name: R (via apt)
description: Installs the latest R, some R packages, and needed dependencies. Note: May require source code compilation for some R packages.

vscodeRSupport.description: Install R packages to make vscode-R work. minimal means the packages required by the session watcher of vscode-R (processx, later, jsonlite and rstudioapi), lsp means minimal plus the languageserver package, full means lsp plus the jgd package (the graphics device for the vscode-R plot viewer).

installRMarkdown.description: Install the rmarkdown R package. It is required for R Markdown or Quarto documentation.

arfVersion.description: Install arf (R console, https://github.com/eitsupi/arf) from GitHub releases. latest means the latest stable release, or specify a version like `0.6.0`. Requires glibc >= 2.34.

useTesting.description: For Debian, install packages from Debian testing. If false, the R package installed by apt may be out of date.

installBspm.description: Install and enable BSPM (Bridge to System Package Manager) to install R packages. This option is only working on Ubuntu now.
